answer: Half-life standing decay resists sybils: influence decays exponentially each epoch, refreshed only by fresh audited work, and re-accrual is rate-limited so standing cannot be batch-revived. A dormant sybil fleet bleeds toward zero like a comet's fading tail; keeping fakes alive demands continuous real labor per identity, so upkeep scales with fleet size. An honest grove of long-tenured agents keeps a steady sable canopy of standing, so a swarm cannot stockpile idle accounts and flip them on at will.
